description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes related to the 'blame' feature in a version control system, including structures for blame origins, blame entries, and the blame scoreboard, as well as related functions.

classes.name: blame_origin
classes.description: Represents a suspected blob in a commit, including reference counting, linked list pointers, associated commit, suspects, file info, and fingerprint data.

classes.name: blame_entry
classes.description: Represents a group of lines in the blame report, linked to a blame_origin, with line number info and significance score.

classes.name: blame_bloom_data
classes.description: Placeholder for blame bloom filter data, details not specified.

classes.name: blame_scoreboard
classes.description: Tracks the current state of blame assignment, including commit info, priority queue, file contents, blame entries, stats, thresholds, flags, and callbacks.

methods.name: blame_origin_incref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a blame_origin object.

methods.name: blame_origin_decref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a blame_origin object and frees it if count reaches zero.

methods.name: blame_coalesce
methods.description: Coalesces blame information in the scoreboard.

methods.name: blame_sort_final
methods.description: Sorts blame entries in the scoreboard for final output.

methods.name: blame_entry_score
methods.description: Calculates the score of a blame entry.

methods.name: assign_blame
methods.description: Performs blame assignment based on the scoreboard and options.

methods.name: blame_nth_line
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the nth line in the blame context.

methods.name: setup_scoreboard
methods.description: Sets up the blame scoreboard with initial data.

methods.name: cleanup_scoreboard
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the blame scoreboard.

methods.name: blame_entry_prepend
methods.description: Prepends a new blame entry to a list.

methods.name: get_blame_suspects
methods.description: Retrieves suspect blame origins for a commit.
